name: Moyi vusa khochut' litaty
source:
Not all cats are lucky enough to be pampered in a warm house with servants who constantly feed you, caress you and respond to your every whim. But I was lucky. I have everything that street cats dream of, but... It's not enough. Something is missing. I feel like I should be somewhere else. But I don't know what to do, where to go, how to live. Every day I return to this question, but I never find an answer. Everything would have continued like this if that day had not come...

[Translated from [url=https://mihapomelo.itch.io/moi-vusa-khochut-litaty]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
并不是所有的猫都足够幸运，能在温暖的房子里得到宠爱，有仆人不断地喂你、爱抚你、回应你的每一个突发奇想。但我很幸运。我拥有流浪猫梦想的一切，但是……这还不够。缺少一些东西。我觉得我应该去别的地方。但我不知道该做什么，去哪里，如何生活。我每天都会回到这个问题，但我从未找到答案。如果没有那一天，一切都会这样继续下去……

[译自[url=https://mihapomelo.itch.io/moi-vusa-khochut-litaty]itch.io[/url]]
